edges.reason: transfer() passes _msgSender() as the originating account
transfer() delegates to _transfer
constructor assigns _rOwned[_msgSender()] and ownership from caller
_owner is set from msg.sender in the constructor
manualswap authorization is based solely on msg.sender equality with _FeeAddress
manualsend authorization is based solely on msg.sender equality with _FeeAddress
setBots is restricted by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to _owner
delBot is restricted by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to _owner
setMaxTxPercent is restricted by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to _owner
cooldown write derives directly from block.timestamp
swapTokensForEth uses block.timestamp as the router deadline
openTrading uses block.timestamp as the liquidity deadline
_transfer performs the external swap before finishing the user state updates
_transfer distributes ETH to external wallets mid-transfer
Router swap call is an external interaction that can call back into the token while inSwap logic and balances are mid-update
swapTokensForEth invokes the router swap operation
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router for approval and swap
sendETHToFee transfers ETH to the fee address
sendETHToFee transfers ETH to the marketing address
_transfer finalizes by calling _tokenTransfer
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard
_transferStandard mutates _rOwned balances with SafeMath sub/add
_takeTeam increases the contract reflective balance using multiplication
_reflectFee subtracts the reflective fee from _rTotal
transferFrom delegates the movement to _transfer
transferFrom decrements the allowance via _approve
openTrading calls the router addLiquidityETH payable operation
openTrading calls the factory createPair operation
setBots writes arbitrary addresses into the bots blacklist
delBot clears blacklist entries controlled by the owner
setMaxTxPercent recomputes _maxTxAmount with mul/div arithmetic
_transfer enforces the owner-controlled _maxTxAmount limit
_transfer reads the bots blacklist before moving tokens
cooldown mapping is persisted from the timestamp-derived write
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply for supply values
_getValues obtains currentRate from _getRate
_getCurrentSupply reads excluded reflective balances from _rOwned
balanceOf derives balances from _rOwned via tokenFromReflection
constructor mints the whole reflective supply to the deployer
manualswap triggers swapTokensForEth
manualsend triggers sendETHToFee

normalization_plan.reason: amount is a transient transfer parameter that only flows into the core _transfer logic
recipient is a transient transfer parameter consumed by the core _transfer logic
sender is a transient parameter expanded into the core _transfer logic
tAmount only parameterizes the reflective balance update in the core transfer variant
takeFee is a transient boolean selecting fee handling inside _tokenTransfer
tokenAmount only parameterizes the core swap operation
bots_ is a transient array consumed by the core setBots blacklist writer
maxTxPercent only parameterizes the core limit update computation
FeeAddress is a constructor parameter stored once into core state
marketingWalletAddress is a constructor parameter stored once into core state
account only parameterizes the core view balance lookup
contractTokenBalance is a transient local feeding the core swap call
currentRate is a transient local produced by the core rate computation
path is a transient local array used only by the core swap operation
contractETHBalance is a transient local feeding the core ETH distribution
